Phase 2 Week 2: Backend Integration - Floating Window System

Implemented complete backend integration for floating window system:

## WindowManagerBridge (228 lines)
python/Backend/Windows/window_manager_bridge.py

QObject bridge connecting QML to FloatingWindowManager:

Signals:
- windowCreated(chartId): Emitted when window is created
- windowRemoved(chartId): Emitted when window is removed  
- windowStateChanged(chartId): Emitted on state changes
- layoutSaved(filename): Emitted after layout save
- layoutLoaded(filename): Emitted after layout load

Slots (callable from QML):
- createWindow(chartId) -> bool
- removeWindow(chartId) -> bool
- getWindowState(chartId) -> dict (JSON serialized WindowState)
- updateWindowPosition(chartId, x, y, width, height)
- dockWindow(chartId, edge, screen_width, screen_height) -> bool
- undockWindow(chartId) -> bool
- minimizeWindow(chartId) -> bool
- maximizeWindow(chartId, screen_width, screen_height) -> bool
- bringToFront(chartId): Update z-order
- saveLayout(filename) -> bool: Persist window layout
- loadLayout(filename) -> bool: Restore window layout

Properties:
- manager: Direct access to FloatingWindowManager instance

## Main Application Integration
python/main.py:
- Import WindowManagerBridge
- Create window_manager instance
- Pass to plotter.set_window_manager()

python/Plotter/plotter.py:
- Import WindowManagerBridge type hint
- Add __window_manager instance variable
- set_window_manager() method registers as QML context property
- Context property name: "WindowManager" (accessible from QML)

## QML Submodule Update
- Updated qml submodule pointer to commit eaac217
- Contains FloatingChartWindow.qml, XYChartRenderer.qml
- App.qml and ChartWindow.qml integration

## Testing Guide
TESTING_FLOATING_WINDOWS.md:
- Complete test scenarios (10 test cases)
- Keyboard shortcuts reference
- Expected log outputs
- Troubleshooting guide
- Next development steps

Testing:
- F11 or "Test Float" button creates test window
- WindowManager accessible from all QML components
- Backend signals propagate to QML
- Window state persists in FloatingWindowManager

Architecture:
QML (FloatingChartWindow) 
  ↓ calls
WindowManager (context property)
  ↓ invokes slots
WindowManagerBridge (QObject)
  ↓ manages
FloatingWindowManager (Python)
  ↓ stores
WindowState (dataclass)

Next: Phase 2 Week 3-4 (3D Charts with Qt3D)
